strings.name: Ken Griffin
strings.summary: Griffin began investing at Harvard and founded Citadel in 1990, later developing separately operated Citadel Securities. He applied quantitative research, risk management and trading infrastructure to investment and market services, while funding education, science and culture. His funds suffered major losses in 2008; he testified in the 2021 GameStop hearing amid debate over market structure and conflicts of interest.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Citadel and helped build hedge-fund and securities-market-making businesses on a global scale.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in 1968 in Daytona Beach, Florida, United States.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.highlights.h1.title: Investment and market making
strings.highlights.h1.text: Built Citadel’s investment business and helped develop the Citadel Securities market-making platform.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Education and research giving
strings.highlights.h2.text: Funded universities, science and culture, including a $300 million Harvard FAS gift in 2023.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Harvard gift
strings.timeline.t1.text: Gave $300 million to Harvard FAS; the graduate school was subsequently named for him.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Miami headquarters
strings.timeline.t2.text: Citadel and Citadel Securities moved global headquarters from Chicago to Miami.
strings.timeline.t3.title: GameStop hearing
strings.timeline.t3.text: Testified to the House Financial Services Committee on trading, market making and Robinhood-related questions.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Financial crisis
strings.timeline.t4.text: Funds suffered major losses and restricted redemptions, subsequently recovering.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Securities market making
strings.timeline.t5.text: Established the Citadel Securities business, distinct from hedge-fund investing entities.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Founded Citadel
strings.timeline.t6.text: Established the investment firm, initially trading with modest capital.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Harvard graduation
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed his economics bachelor’s and entered full-time finance.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Student investing
strings.timeline.t8.text: Began investing from a Harvard dormitory, later developing convertible-bond strategies.
